fates.name: Memory Scrolls
fates.description: Use (1 charges): -1 Cultivation. Choose 1 sect card from your current card pool.

fates.name: Dao Severing Method
fates.description: Use (2 charges): -3 Cultivation. Draw 3 cards.

fates.name: Side Job Research
fates.description: Use (1 charges): -1 Cultivation. Choose 1 side job card from your current card pool.

fates.name: Blaze a New Trail
fates.description: Use (2 charges): Transform all cards in hand into random cards.

fates.name: Ambush
fates.description: Use (2 charges): Next battle: +6  Speed .

fates.name: Battlefield Epiphany
fates.description: Use (1 charges): Reduces the Cultivation and Physique required for the next Phase Breakthrough by 5

fates.name: Calm Enlightenment
fates.description: Use (1 charges): Upgrade the first level 1 card in deck.

fates.name: Side Job Change
fates.description: Use (1 charge): Reselect your side job. Remove remaining old side job cards and side job cards below your previous phase from pool.

fates.name: Learn from Opponent
fates.description: Use (1 charges): -1 Cultivation. Choose 1  regular  card from last opponent's deck.

fates.name: Phase Mastery
fates.description: Use (1 charges): Increase count of all current phase cards in pool by 4.

fates.name: Dream Recall
fates.description: Use (1 charges): -1 Cultivation. Choose 1 from 3 random Dream cards. On breakthrough, automatically raise the Phase of Dream cards in hand or deck.

fates.name: Qi Practice
fates.description: Use (3 charges): -1 Cultivation, +1 Exchange Chance. Draw 1 sect card with  Qi -related effects.

fates.name: Defense Practice
fates.description: Use (3 charges): -1 Cultivation, +1 Exchange Chance. Draw 1 sect card with  DEF -related effects.

fates.name: Immortality Practice
fates.description: Use (4 charges): -1 Cultivation, +1 Exchange Chance. Draw 1 sect card (Immortality preferred).

fates.name: Formation Rune Engraving
fates.description: Use (2 charges): Upgrade the first  Continuous  card in deck.

fates.name: Mutant Watering
fates.description: Use (2 charges):  Mutate  1 random spirit plant card in hand that can  Mutate .

fates.name: Spontaneous Enlightenment
fates.description: Use (1 charges): Upgrade 1 random Immortality or Incarnation card in hand or deck.

fates.name: Meditation Enhancement
fates.description: Use (2 charges): Upgrade 1 random Meditation phase  Regular Card  in hand or deck.

fates.name: Treasure Chest
fates.description: Use (2 charges): Lose 1 Cultivation, choose 1 card from 3 random cards with Absorb effects (May include special or high-level cards).

fates.name: Defy Fate
fates.description: Use (1 charges): Lose 1 Cultivation and 10 Destiny (minimum 1). Lose your current Phase's Immortal Fate, revert to the previous Phase, and can breakthrough again to choose a new Immortal Fate.

fates.name: Diligent Training
fates.description: Use (6-round cooldown): Cultivation +1, Max HP -2.
tags: Not: Xiao Bu, Tu Kui, Ye Mingming, Ji Fangsheng, Li Man, Ling Yu

fates.name: Side Job Master
fates.description: Use (2-round cooldown): -1 Cultivation. Draw 1 side job card (Prioritize Immortality phase or higher).

fates.name: Thrice-Pondered Choice
fates.description: Use (3-round cooldown): -1 Cultivation. Choose 1 card from 3 random cards.

fates.name: Reason By Analogy
fates.description: Use (2-round cooldown): -1 Cultivation. Choose 1 from 5 random side job cards (Virtuoso+).

fates.name: Chase Master
fates.description: Use (2-round cooldown): -1 Cultivation. Draw 1 sect card with  Chase  or  Agility  effects (Prioritize Immortality phase or higher).

fates.name: Protective Artifact
fates.description: Use (2-round cooldown): Next battle: gain 2 stacks of  Guard Up .

fates.name: Bronze Mirror (Capacity Grade)
fates.description: Use (3-round cooldown): -1 Cultivation, -2 Destiny (min 1). Choose a Virtuoso or lower phase  Regular Card  in hand or deck, gain a level 1 copy.

fates.name: Bronze Mirror (Marvel Grade)
fates.description: Use (3-round cooldown): -1 Cultivation, -4 Destiny (min 1). Choose an Immortality or lower phase  Regular Card  in hand or deck, gain a level 1 copy.

fates.name: Bronze Mirror (Divine Grade)
fates.description: Use (3-round cooldown): -1 Cultivation, -6 Destiny (min 1). Choose an Incarnation or lower phase  Regular Card  in hand or deck, gain a level 1 copy.

fates.name: Explore the Unknown
fates.description: Use (3-round cooldown): Lose 1 Cultivation, choose 1 card from 3 random cards to obtain (Prioritizes cards not yet obtained this game).

fates.name: Fate Path - Fortunes and Luck
fates.description: Each breakthrough, Immortal Fate options always include  Fortunes and Luck ; Absorbing fortune cards grants 5 extra Exchange Chance.

fates.name: Fate Path - Meteor Quench
fates.description: Each breakthrough, Immortal Fate options always include  Meteor Quench ;  Meteor Quench  Destiny cost halved.

fates.name: Fate Path - Thunder Tribulation
fates.description: Each breakthrough, Immortal Fate options always include  Thunder Tribulation

fates.name: Fate Path - The Way of Adaptation
fates.description: Gain 1 extra Exchange Chance each round but Exchange Chance storage cap becomes 1; each breakthrough, Immortal Fate options always include  The Way of Adaptation .

fates.name: Fate Path - Store Qi
fates.description: Each breakthrough, Immortal Fate options always include  Store Qi .

fates.name: Daoist Rhyme Aura
fates.description: Round 13+: -2 Cultivation, gain 2  Daoist Rhyme Aura .

fates.name: Shadow Owl Rabbit
fates.description: Round 14+: -1 Cultivation, gain 1  Shadow Owl Rabbit .
